note: Higher levels are better on every Score. Level text describes a situation and stands alone; the model never sees a level's number.

single_job.instructions: How many distinct jobs does the function in `function` perform?
criteria: The function performs several unrelated jobs, such as checking input, changing stored state, starting other work and notifying other parts of the system
The function performs two or three separable jobs that could each be a function of its own
The function performs one job, with a few supporting steps that belong to that job
The function performs exactly one small, clearly bounded job

naming.instructions: How well do the names in `function` (the function itself, its parameters and its local variables) tell a reader what each thing is?
criteria: A name is misleading: the function or a variable does something its name does not say
Names are vague placeholders such as data, tmp, x, flag, handle or process that do not say what the thing is
Most names are descriptive and a few are generic
Every name states what the thing is or does

local_reasoning.instructions: How much does a reader need to know outside `function` to change it safely?
criteria: The function reads or changes shared state that is not passed in, and what it does depends on what other code did earlier
The function changes its arguments or stored state in a way a caller would not expect from its name and signature
The function has side effects, and they are the ones its name and signature state
The function depends only on its arguments and returns a value

more_than_one_job.instructions: Does the function in `function` perform more than one separable job?

criteria.true: At least two parts of the function could each stand alone as a function with its own purpose.
criteria.false: Every step in the function serves the same single purpose.

name_covers_behavior.instructions: Does the name of the function in `function` describe everything the function does?

criteria.true: Nothing the function does would surprise a caller who read only its name.
criteria.false: The function does something a caller who read only its name would not expect.
